Hello Sarah, welcome to the department.

**(1) Handbook.** It's the department's rules; the full text is kept by the department office (drop by, or ask and it will be sent to you). The parts that matter most for someone new:

- Working hours are Mon-Fri, 09:00-17:00. Official events are fixed; a cancellation counts only if the office confirms it in writing — "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough, ask the office first.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments: don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one. A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar.
- Students attend their lectures and sections; a lecture is missed only if the office confirms it is cancelled. Meetings with your advisor go into your free time; TAs make time for their course's staff meetings.
- Nobody's schedule or whereabouts is shared with a third party without that person's consent.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to the department office or the equity office as a formal complaint.
- The office (`department`) keeps and announces the official schedule; only it announces a cancellation or move.
